kpis.signal: Portefeuille mondial de pres de 150 000 pylones, coeur du modele REIT locatif.

kpis.name_fr: Croissance organique de la facturation locataires
kpis.signal: Croissance organique des loyers à 1,7 % au T1-2026, en net repli après des années à 5-6 %, équivalent same-store du REIT de tours.

kpis.name_fr: Croissance totale de la facturation locataires
kpis.signal: Croissance totale des loyers à 2,3 % au T1-2026, incluant nouveaux sites et acquisitions, en ralentissement marqué.

kpis.name_fr: Rachats d'actions cumules depuis Q4
kpis.signal: Plus de 565M$ rachetes depuis la reprise des rachats au Q4-2025, plus gros programme annuel depuis 2017.

kpis.name_fr: Revenus services record
kpis.signal: Niveau record de revenus services en 2025, plus haut depuis l'époque où AMT possédait des firmes de construction dans les années 2000.

kpis.short: Data center power held for development
kpis.name_fr: Puissance data centers réservée au développement
kpis.signal: Environ 487 MW réservés au développement CoreSite après ajout de 200 MW sur un an, socle de la croissance data centers.

kpis.name_fr: Revenus DISH retires de la guidance
kpis.signal: Environ 200M$ de revenus annuels DISH (4% du chiffre US&Canada) retires suite au defaut, contrat couru jusqu'en 2036.

kpis.short: Planned new tower sites in Europe
kpis.name_fr: Nouveaux sites Europe planifies
kpis.signal: Plus de 700 nouveaux sites planifiés en Europe en 2026, record de constructions dans la région.

kpis.name_fr: Croissance consommation data mobile US
kpis.signal: Consommation data mobile US en hausse d'environ 35% en 2024, troisieme annee consecutive a ce rythme.

kpis.name_fr: Levier net dans la cible
kpis.signal: Levier net ramene a 4.9x, de retour dans la fourchette cible 3-5x et le plus bas parmi les pairs tours.

kpis.name_fr: Revenus de baux non resiliables futurs
kpis.signal: Plus de 54 Md$ de revenus locatifs contractuels non résiliables sur les périodes futures, visibilité pluriannuelle exceptionnelle.

kpis.short: Loss on India market exit (ATC TIPL)
kpis.name_fr: Perte de sortie du marché indien (ATC TIPL)
kpis.signal: Perte de 1,25 Md$ sur la cession d ATC TIPL, marquant la sortie totale du marché indien (~1,1 Md$ de coût cumulé de sortie).

kpis.short: Gain on sale of South Africa Fiber
kpis.name_fr: Gain sur cession de la fibre Afrique du Sud
kpis.signal: Gain de 53,6 M$ sur la vente de l activité fibre en Afrique du Sud, poursuite du recentrage sur marchés développés.

kpis.name_fr: Liquidites disponibles
kpis.signal: 11,1 Md$ de liquidites disponibles au 31/12/2025, position financiere robuste.

kpis.short: AFFO attributable to common stockholders per share
kpis.name_fr: AFFO par action
kpis.signal: AFFO par action a 2,84 $ au T1-2026, en hausse continue, mesure cle de la capacite de distribution du REIT.

kpis.name_fr: Marge brute immobiliere
kpis.signal: Marge brute immobiliere a 75,1 % au T1-2026, proxy de la rentabilite NOI des actifs de tours.

kpis.name_fr: Portefeuille total de sites de communication
kpis.signal: American Tower exploite 149 686 sites de communication dans le monde fin 2025
kpis.description: Au 31 décembre 2025, American Tower possède et exploite un portefeuille de 149 686 sites de communication, dont 862 réseaux DAS, réparti aux États-Unis, au Canada et sur les marchés internationaux.

kpis.name_fr: Nouveaux sites acquis ou construits en 2025
kpis.name_en: New sites acquired or built in 2025
kpis.signal: Le groupe a ajoute environ 2 230 sites de communication dans le monde en 2025
kpis.description: En 2025, American Tower a fait croitre son portefeuille immobilier de communication via l'acquisition et la construction d'environ 2 230 sites, principalement en Afrique, Asie-Pacifique, Europe et Amerique latine.

kpis.name_fr: Revenu du segment Data Centers
kpis.signal: Le segment Data Centers progresse de 14% et pese desormais 10% du chiffre d'affaires total
kpis.description: Le segment Data Centers d'American Tower, issu de l'acquisition CoreSite, a généré 1 053,1 M$ de revenus en 2025 contre 924,8 M$ en 2024, soit une hausse de 14%, et représente 10% du chiffre d'affaires total du groupe.

kpis.name_fr: Croissance du chiffre d'affaires total
kpis.signal: Le chiffre d'affaires total atteint 10,64 Mds$ en 2025, en hausse de 5%
kpis.description: American Tower a généré 10 644,6 M$ de revenus totaux en 2025 contre 10 127,2 M$ en 2024 (+5%), portés par la croissance du segment Data Centers (+14%) et des activités Services (+75%).

kpis.name_fr: Dividende verse par action en 2025
kpis.signal: American Tower a verse 6,72 $ par action a ses actionnaires en 2025, soit 3,1 Mds$
kpis.description: En tant que REIT, American Tower a distribue 6,72 $ par action a ses actionnaires ordinaires en 2025, representant un montant total de 3,1 milliards de dollars, conformement a l'obligation de distribution de 90% du revenu imposable.

kpis.name_fr: Rachats d'actions au quatrieme trimestre 2025
kpis.signal: American Tower a rachete 2,04 millions d'actions pour 364,6 M$ au T4 2025
kpis.description: Au quatrieme trimestre 2025, American Tower a rachete un total de 2 036 100 actions ordinaires pour un montant agrege de 364,6 M$, dans le cadre de ses programmes de rachat 2011 et 2017, ce dernier disposant encore de capacite disponible.

risks.title: Decreased Leasing Demand for Communications Infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: A significant reduction in leasing demand would materially and adversely affect business and operating results. Risk is driven by wireless/cloud provider capex decisions, communications service provider consolidation, economic conditions, and technological changes including AI and RAN sharing. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We own and operate data center facilities and related assets in the United States, which". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Significant decrease in leasing demand for communications infrastructure could materially impact business and operating results due to economic conditions, carrier consolidation, technology shifts, or spectrum licensing changes.

risks.title: Litiges et différends avec les clients
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing disputes with major customers (AT&T Mexico representing ~$300M annual revenue, DISH representing ~2% of total property revenue) present material financial and operational risks, with potential negative impact on results and reputation. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Services Operations We offer tower-related services in the United States, including site application, zoning and". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Current arbitration with AT&T Mexico over lease payment calculations and DISH contract disputes could result in material revenue loss, accounting reserves, and operational disruption.

risks.title: Risque de concentration client
risks.score_rationale: Heavy dependence on wireless carriers and communications service providers creates concentration risk. Loss of major customer would have material negative impact on revenues and business continuity. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We believe that, in certain international markets, we can create value by expanding our existing". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Concentration of customer base among wireless carriers and communications service providers increases revenue volatility and downside risk from individual customer loss or consolidation.

risks.title: Concurrence accrue
risks.score_rationale: Growing competition in communications infrastructure could pressure lease rates, margins, and customer retention, particularly from alternative infrastructure providers and network sharing arrangements. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "We also analyze (i) the competitiveness of the country s wireless market and (ii) how". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Increased competition in communications infrastructure leasing could result in downward pricing pressure and reduced growth opportunities.

risks.title: Technological Disruption
risks.score_rationale: Emerging technologies including AI, satellite communications, RAN sharing, and wireless equipment changes could reduce demand for traditional tower infrastructure and accelerate infrastructure obsolescence. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "As a result, we anticipate growing demand for our communications sites because they are attractively". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Technological advancements including artificial intelligence, satellite technology, and RAN sharing among wireless providers could reduce customer demand for traditional communications infrastructure.

risks.title: Activités de désinvestissement et transitions de portefeuille
risks.score_rationale: Recent divestitures (South Africa Fiber in 2025, ATC TIPL in 2024) create transition execution risk and potential asset value realization challenges, though currently limited impact. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "In addition to the communications sites in our portfolio, we manage rooftop and tower sites". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Ongoing portfolio optimization through divestitures could create execution risks and affect revenue continuity during transition periods.

risks.title: Risques réglementaires et de conformité
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory changes affecting zoning, environmental rules, spectrum licensing, taxation, and REIT compliance requirements could increase operating costs and limit business expansion. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "In addition, we are subject to risks related to our international operations, as set forth". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Changes in zoning, environmental, health, tax, and REIT regulations could increase costs and restrict business operations and growth.

company_description: American Tower Corporation is one of the largest global real estate investment trusts. It is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate. The Company's primary business is the leasing of space on communications sites to wireless service providers, radio and television broadcast companies, wireless data providers, government agencies and municipalities and tenants in a few other industries. The Company refers to this business, inclusive of its data center business discussed below, as its property operations. Additionally, the Company offers tower-related services in the United States, which the Company refers to as its services operations. These services include site application, zoning and permitting, structural and mount analyses, and construction management services, together with program management offerings that support customer deployment needs from project scoping through construction. The Company's services operations primarily support the Company's site leasing business, including through the addition of new tenants and equipment on its sites. The Company's customers include its tenants, licensees and other payers. American
